info.title: Thoth API
info.description:
Versioned REST + WebSocket API (v1) for the Thoth local-first knowledge base. Every route lives under `/api/v1/...`; the chat WebSocket upgrades at `/ws/v1`. The server binds to localhost only and requires no authentication; every endpoint assumes a trusted local caller.

Error responses use the envelope `{"error": "<message>"}` — 400 client error, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 500 always the generic `{"error": "internal error"}` (details go to the server log only).

The WebSocket chat protocol (`/ws/v1`) is documented in prose in `docs/api.md` (frames and semantics); this spec describes the upgrade only.

servers.description: Local dev server — the API reference is served only under serve --dev (the docs page and /swagger.json do not exist in normal serve)

tags.name: settings
tags.description: Settings key/value surface and model registry

tags.name: github
tags.description: GitHub identity, git sync, and repo suggestions

get.description: Reports the backend state (native agent, api-key presence, selected model and its provider), the wiki root, build version, dev-mode flag, the dev commit id, and the mode's default wiki path. `api_key_configured` reports only whether a key is stored — the key itself is never returned.
Runs the shared `internal/doctor` suite — the same checks as `thoth doctor` — against the thoth dir the server runs from.
Searches the wiki index. `q` is treated as a literal phrase (embedded quotes stripped, FTS5 operators matched literally). `limit` defaults to 20 and is clamped to 1–100.

Reads a wiki-relative path. Markdown paths return `{path, content}`; attachments (images, scripts, configs) are returned as raw bytes — images inline with an image/* Content-Type, everything else as a download with `Content-Disposition: attachment`. 400 when the path is missing or escapes the wiki root (SafePath); 404 when the file doesn't exist.

200.description: Markdown note content (attachments return raw bytes instead)

post.summary: Promote a chat answer into a wiki note
post.description: Files markdown content into the wiki as a permanent note via the same save path the assistant's own saves use (wiki.Save): frontmatter with title/date/type matching the folder, kebab-case filename, validated through wiki.Validate. The folder defaults to the first configured folder; the title defaults to the content's first heading/line. The saved note is searchable immediately and appears in the wiki tree.

get.description: Returns the wiki file tree. A directory that exists but cannot be read (permissions) stays in the tree with an `error` and no children, so one locked folder never fails the whole tree; only an unreadable root 500s.

500.description: Unreadable wiki root — generic internal error

get.description: Streams a zip of the wiki tree — folders, notes, attachments and the CLAUDE.md rulebook — for backup or transfer. `history=1` also includes dotfiles (.git) so git history travels; the default export skips dotfile tooling except .gitkeep. The zip is streamed (never fully buffered), so large wikis stay memory-bounded. 404 when the wiki root does not exist.

parameters.name: history
parameters.description: When 1, include dotfiles/.git in the export

post.summary: Import a wiki from a zip
post.description: Validates a multipart wiki zip and merges it onto the wiki root as a backup-first merge: the existing tree is copied to a sibling `<root>-backup-<timestamp>` directory first, then the archive's files are laid over it (archive wins on conflicts, local-only files are kept). Every entry is validated for path traversal, the archive must be wiki-shaped (a root CLAUDE.md or a markdown note with frontmatter), and the index is rebuilt so search and the tree reflect the imported files. The request body is capped at 200 MiB.

files.description: Number of files merged into the wiki root

backup.description: Pre-import backup directory path, or null when none was created

400.description: Missing file, malformed zip, path traversal, or a non-wiki archive

500.description: Internal error — reindex or merge failure

get.description: Returns the immediate subdirectories of an absolute path (lexically sorted), powering the Settings directory picker. 400 when the path is missing or not a readable directory.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Absolute directory path (a leading ~ is expanded)

get.description: Returns the settings key/value surface. Per-provider api keys are write-only: `has_api_key` reports whether one is stored, the key itself is never returned.

put.description: Upserts the settings table. An empty/omitted per-provider `api_key` leaves the stored key unchanged; `base_url` round-trips (empty clears back to the provider default). 400 when `wiki_path` is empty.

get.description: Returns the llm_models table grouped by provider (providers sorted A→Z, models in seed order), seeded from internal/assets/models.json on first boot and user-editable afterwards.

post.description: Adds a row to the llm_models registry. 400 when `value` or `name` is empty; 409 when the value is taken.

409.description: A model with this value already exists

put.description: Updates the model's fields. Renaming the selected model's value moves the `model` setting to it. 400 invalid body, 404 unknown id, 409 value collision.

409.description: A model with this value already exists

delete.description: Deletes the model row; deleting the selected model clears the `model` setting (next boot falls back to the first seeded claude model). 404 when the model is missing.

get.description: Returns every provider row (sorted A→Z), each with its model count and key presence. Providers exist before their models, so the list includes rows with zero models.

post.description: Adds a provider row. 400 when `name` is empty; 409 when the name is taken.

409.description: A provider with this name already exists

put.description: Updates the provider's name and base URL; the api key is write-only, so an empty value leaves the stored key untouched. 400 invalid body, 404 unknown id, 409 name collision.

409.description: A provider with this name already exists

delete.description: Deletes the provider and its models; deleting a provider whose model is selected clears the `model` setting. 404 when the provider is missing.

get.description: Returns every conversation with its id, title, and creation time.

post.description: Creates a conversation with the given title. 400 when title is missing.

200.description: The created conversation id and title

get.summary: Get a conversation with its messages
get.description: Returns the conversation and its full message history. Each assistant message may carry an optional `usage` token breakdown. 404 when the id is unknown.

delete.description: Removes the conversation and its messages; deleting a missing conversation is a no-op (idempotent).

get.description: Upgrades to the Thoth chat WebSocket. The full frame protocol and semantics are documented in `docs/api.md` — frames: send/cancel/resume/open/new_chat/presence out, assistant_start/assistant_thinking/assistant_delta/tool_activity/turn_done/wiki_changed/error in. Only localhost origins are accepted on the upgrade.

101.description: Switching Protocols — the socket is open

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI spec for the REST API. Served only in `--dev` mode (excluded by `--no-api-docs`); the route does not exist in normal serve, so tools must fetch it from a dev server.
The sync provider catalog: built-ins (github, gitlab, aws_s3, local) plus user rows, each with the driver's field descriptors.

post.description: Adds a provider type (a known driver with a custom name/base URL). 400 unknown driver.

delete.description: 409 while connections reference it; protected providers are 403.

get.description: Every configured destination with token-free identity and config.

post.description: Verifies credentials against the provider and stores the connection. Secrets never echo.

get.description: One connection with token-free identity and config.

put.description: Edits name/enabled/config. Secret config values with an empty value keep the stored one.

delete.description: Removes the connection; the protected local backup is 403.

get.description: Selectable destinations for a connected account (repos for git providers; empty otherwise).

post.description: Syncs the wiki through the connection's driver. Transient failures are retried with backoff; returns ok:false with a sanitized message on failure. Records the outcome (last_synced_at/last_error + push history) on the connection row.

get.description: Restore points available for a connection (S3 objects / local backup files), newest-first. Git-kind connections return an empty list — they have no stored archives to restore from.

400.description: restore is not supported for this destination

post.summary: Restore the wiki from a snapshot
post.description: Downloads a stored archive (the latest, or the chosen snapshot key) and imports it onto the wiki via the backup-first merge flow, then reindexes and pushes a wiki_changed frame. The wiki is overwritten by the archive — a sibling backup is taken first, so nothing is lost.

key.description: Snapshot key to restore; empty selects the latest.

400.description: restore not supported or a bad/non-wiki archive

post.description: Marks the connection the agent's git tools default to.

content.description: Markdown content to promote into a note

folder.description: Target folder, e.g. knowledge. Defaults to the first configured folder.

path.description: Wiki-relative path of the created note

dev.description: true under serve --dev (the UI shows a warning banner)

commit.description: Full git commit id the dev server runs from; empty otherwise

default_wiki_path.description: The mode's wiki default in tilde form, e.g. ~/.thoth/wiki

api_key_configured.description: Whether a per-provider api key is stored — the key itself is never returned

provider.description: Provider label of the selected model's llm_models row

error.description: Present when the directory exists but cannot be read (e.g. permissions); children omitted

wiki_folders.description: Configured scaffold folder set ([] when unset → defaults)

base_url.description: API base URL override; empty means the provider's default endpoint

api_key.description: Write-only: PUT treats an empty value as leave unchanged

base_url.description: Provider base URL override; empty means the provider default

has_api_key.description: GET reports only whether a key is stored; the key itself is never returned

model_count.description: Number of models registered under this provider

provider_id.description: Owning provider's row id (0/null = the Unassigned catch-all)

provider.description: The owning provider's name (empty for unassigned)

provider_id.description: The owning provider's row id (0 = unassigned)

usage.description: Token breakdown on the assistant message that ended a turn; absent on user messages and pre-telemetry rows

config.description: non-secret fields round-trip; secret fields are has_<key> booleans
